answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price admission like an orchard: every new agent plants a living stake, an opal-graded bond locked in escrow, and earns voting weight only after established peers sample its work, the way an orchard keeper grades fruit before paying. Duplicate output burns the deposit, so flooding fake identities means sinking pearls of collateral that never pay back — each impostor funds the very audits that unmask it.
